data.body: **P2 — Let reported scope fatals wake the invocation caller.** This observer is driven only by `executionFuture`. If a scope reports a fatal and an earlier scope then blocks during reverse cleanup, neither handler nor execution future completes, so the caller remains in `ready.join()` until Lambda timeout despite `scopeFatal` already being set. Represent the fatal as a completion signal raced with `executionFuture`, then perform the bounded handoff before rethrowing it; add a two-scope regression with a later fatal close and an earlier blocked close.
